criteria.requirement: Extend footnotes(md,*,unique_refs=False) with an explicit compatibility-preserving mode. Each occurrence of one defined footnote gets a unique fnref-N, fnref-N-2,... HTML id and the footnote item links back to all occurrences. Keep one note definition/order/index and expose occurrence metadata in opted-in AST tokens; unknown references remain literal. Reset counts per parsed document, preserve escaping and legacy default HTML/AST exactly, and verify document reuse plus interaction with directory extraction.
